items.prompt: Look at the picture. Write four sentences about the weather and what you can do.

figure.alt: The sun, rain and a rainbow.

hints: Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

criteria.label: Writes about the picture or the topic

planning: What can or cannot you do?
items.model: It is sunny and rainy today. There is a beautiful rainbow in the sky. I cannot play outside. I will read a book at home.
